maya (Billing Ops): Quick flag 1 customers reported invoice anomalies for April batch: missing line items (compute usage) on PDFs and one case of the same invoice_id sent twice. sample snippet pasted below. :mag:

maya (Billing Ops): Sample PDF extract (redacted):
```
Invoice: 2025-04-INV-1102
Customer: betacorp
Lines:
 - Monthly reserved capacity: $1000
 - Usage (API tokens): $0  <-- should be $320
 - Tax: $80
 Total: $1080
```

sanjay (FinOps): Missing usage line shows amount 0? Could be a query join issue between usage table and pricing table. Did we change the pricing experiment flag last week?

maya (Billing Ops): We toggled the "pricing-experiment-v2" feature for a subset on 1769950000.

olivia (Payments): If PDFs show $0 for usage but our ledger has the correct charge, customers will dispute. We need to know which canonical source is wrong: PDF rendering vs invoice record.

harry (Support): I already have a ticket from Betacorp. They uploaded both PDFs and their billing portal shows full charges. They were emailed two PDFs: one with missing usage line and one correct. They've been charged only once. Confusing for customers.

deply-bot: (no such bot)

deply-bot: sorry mis-typed

deploy-bot: Deploy event: invoice-renderer v1.14.0 promoted to prod at 1769988000 by ci/build.

maya (Billing Ops): Running quick db checks: SELECT invoice_id, count(*) FROM invoice_pdfs WHERE period='2025-04' GROUP BY invoice_id HAVING count(*)>1; -> returns 3 rows including 2025-04-INV-1102. Also checking invoices table for missing lines.

sanjay (FinOps): Can you run a reconciliation between invoice_lines and usage_aggregates? Something like:
```
SELECT i.invoice_id, sum(il.amount) as line_total, u.usage_total FROM invoices i
LEFT JOIN invoice_lines il ON il.invoice_id=i.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN usage_aggregates u ON u.customer_id=i.customer_id AND u.period='2025-04'
WHERE i.period='2025-04' AND coalesce(sum(il.amount),0)<>coalesce(u.usage_total,0)
GROUP BY i.invoice_id, u.usage_total;
```

maya (Billing Ops): Ran and found 5 mismatches. For the 3 duplicate PDFs invoice_ids, the invoice_lines table entries are correct. The renderer sometimes omits lines when pricing-experiment flag is set and the feature path returns empty line templates.

olivia (Payments): So charge is correct in ledger but some customers got misleading PDFs. That reduces legal exposure but we still need to fix communication and reissue corrected PDFs. Also pause emailing invoice attachments until fixed.

elaine (Acct Mgmt): I'll prepare a customer note: short, apologetic, explain corrected PDF will be reissued and that charges are accurate. Need list of affected customers for outreach.

maya (Billing Ops): Steps proposed: 1) pause PDF emailing job 2) mark affected invoices with status=pdf_pending_correction 3) re-render PDFs with renderer pinned to v1.13.9 which didn't have the experiment codepath 4) re-send corrected PDFs and a short note.

sanjay (FinOps): Eng wanted logs. Attaching renderer output: ERROR render_line(): missing template for line_key 'usage_v2' for invoice 2025-04-INV-1102 when feature_flag pricing-experiment-v2=true

deploy-bot: Can rollback invoice-renderer to v1.13.9. Preflight: 0 running jobs depend on v1.14.0. Proceed? (yes/no)

maya (Billing Ops): Please rollback renderer first, then requeue affected invoice_ids for re-render. I'll coordinate with Payments to hold emails.

olivia (Payments): Paused email pipeline and set gateway holds for customers who reported duplicate PDFs.

harry (Support): I'll notify Betacorp that we're reissuing corrected PDF and that their charge is unchanged. Thanks.

sanjay (FinOps): After rollback, we should also add a regression test to invoice-renderer for feature flags so line templates aren't skipped. Filing a follow-up action.

maya (Billing Ops): Created ticket FIN-2025-142 with attached logs and list of affected invoice_ids. Assigning to eng-billing. Will update thread when re-render completes. :white_check_mark:
